transcript: Bathroom exhaust fan replacement for Clara Oswald, 76 Coal Hill Crescent. Removed noisy builder-grade fan. Installed an eighty CFM Panasonic WhisperCeiling exhaust fan with humidity sensor. Ran twenty feet of four-inch insulated flexible ducting through the attic to a new aluminum roof cap. Sealed joints with foil tape. Needed four hours of labor total. Panasonic fan is one hundred sixty dollars.

expected.job_summary: 80 CFM bathroom exhaust fan, ducting, and roof cap installation
expected.notes: Sealed duct joints with foil tape in attic.
